node.title: Re: print tab within an element of an array
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Going a bit overkill, but the following supports a large subset of the escape sequences supported by Perl ([doc://perlop#Quote-and-Quote-like-Operators]). Even though it uses [doc://eval] (via s///ee) it's fairly safe as it only evaluates known escape sequences.

$str =~ s{( \\ (?: [tnrfbae\\] | [xNo] \{ [-+,\w ]* \} | [0-7]{1,3} | x[0-9A-Fa-f]{0,2} | c[\@A-Za-z[\]^_?] ) )}{ qq{"$1"} }msxeeg;
